name: Plate Reverb
purpose: Plate reverb for bright, dense ambience; the classic choice for lead vocals and snare.

expose.ai_hint: Dry signal level. Keep at 100% when used as an insert; Plugsalot later moves reverbs to sends.
Reverb level. 10-20% for a subtle vocal plate.
Simple, Nested (default, smooth) or Tank (bigger, thicker).
20-40 ms keeps a vocal clear in front of its reverb.
Tail length in seconds; 0.6-1.2 s for vocals at mid tempos.
Raise to 150-300 Hz to stop the reverb muddying the low mids.
Lower to darken the tail and reduce sibilant splash.

notes: Upstream symbol for wet level is 'early_level'; exposed here as 'wet'.
Defaults come from the upstream default preset, Bright Plate.
CPU: 0.43% of one core at 48 kHz on Plugsalot's 2-core build machine (plugin/tests/TestMain.cpp); 1 point per 2%, minimum 1.
